data.description: Elegant 1BR Apartment in Royal Regency Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover elevated urban living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment at Royal Regency Suites, ideally located in the heart of Business Bay. Spanning 891.46 sq ft, this modern residence offers a perfect combination of contemporary design, comfort, and prime city connectivity, making it an excellent choice for both end-users and investors.


  The apartment features a spacious open-plan living and dining area enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in abundant natural light while offering stunning city views. The modern kitchen is thoughtfully designed with premium cabinetry, sleek countertops, and high-quality finishes. The generously sized bedroom includes built-in wardrobes and a stylish en-suite bathroom, creating a sophisticated and relaxing living environment.


  Residents of Royal Regency enjoy access to premium lifestyle amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. The development includes a state-of-the-art fitness center, swimming pool, landscaped leisure areas, 24/7 security, concierge services, and dedicated covered parking.


  Located in one of Dubai’s most dynamic districts, the property provides seamless access to major landmarks and destinations including:


 
 Downtown Dubai
 
 Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall
 
 DIFC
 
 Dubai Canal
 
 Sheikh Zayed Road
 
 Dubai International Airport


  Key Features:


 
 1 Bedroom Apartment
 
 Size: 891.46 sq ft
 
 Spacious Layout
 
 Modern Open Kitchen
 
 Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
 
 Built-in Wardrobes
 
 Premium Finishes
